fields.name: __FirstSpeaker__Voice
fields.label: Who speaks first
fields.description: Choose whether the visitor or the Voice AI starts the conversation.

selectOptions.label: AI
selectOptions.description: The Voice AI opens the conversation with the introduction below.

selectOptions.label: Human
selectOptions.description: The Voice AI waits for the visitor's first message.

fields.name: __Introduction__Voice
fields.label: Introduction
fields.description: Message the Voice AI sends when the AI speaks first. Required when the AI speaks first.

fields.name: __Goal__Voice
fields.label: Goal
fields.description: What the Voice AI should achieve in the conversation.

fields.name: __Role__Voice
fields.label: Role
fields.description: Who the Voice AI is and how it should present itself.

fields.name: __Instructions__Voice
fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: Rules and guidance the Voice AI must follow.

fields.name: __ManagerAgent__Voice
fields.label: Manager Agent
fields.description: Optional manager agent name or id used when this agent hands work over.

fields.name: __EngineMode__Voice
fields.label: Engine Mode
fields.description: Choose how the agent handles speech. Realtime uses one realtime model for both listening and speaking; Pipeline chains separate speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech steps. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

selectOptions.label: Realtime
selectOptions.description: A single realtime model handles listening and speaking.

selectOptions.label: Pipeline
selectOptions.description: Separate speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech steps.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__RealtimeVoice
fields.label: Realtime Model
fields.description: Model used when Engine Mode is Realtime. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__Voice
fields.label: LLM
fields.description: Model used when Engine Mode is Pipeline. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__SpeechToText
fields.description: Speech-to-text model used when Engine Mode is Pipeline. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __ModelConfig__TextToSpeech
fields.description: Text-to-speech model used when Engine Mode is Pipeline. The selection is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __VoiceConfig__TextToSpeech
fields.description: Voice, language, and speed used for speech in both Realtime and Pipeline modes.

fields.name: __CallRecording__Voice
fields.label: Call Recording
fields.description: Records each voice session. The setting is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __PreemptiveGeneration__Voice
fields.label: Preemptive Generation
fields.description: Starts preparing a reply before the caller finishes speaking. The setting is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

fields.name: __NoiseCancellation__Voice
fields.label: Noise Cancellation
fields.description: Reduces background noise in the caller audio. The setting is stored with the flow and honored by a later runtime change.

selectOptions.label: Auto
selectOptions.description: Let the platform choose the noise reduction.

fields.name: __PronunciationEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Pronunciation
fields.description: Use the pronunciation list below when the voice speaks. Turn this off to keep the list but speak the original text.

fields.name: __Pronunciation__Voice
fields.label: Pronunciation
fields.description: Speak terms, names, and acronyms with an intended pronunciation. Add a term and how it should be spoken, for example term API spoken as A P I. Matching is case-insensitive and uses the longest term first. Applies to providers that support speech synthesis.

fields.name: __VariablesEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Dynamic Variables
fields.description: Fill {{name}} placeholders in the goal, role, instructions, and introduction with the values below. Turn this off to keep the values but leave placeholders as written.

fields.name: __Variables__Voice
fields.label: Variables
fields.description: Default values for placeholders used in the Goal, Role, Instructions, and Introduction. Add a name and value pair, for example name company_name with value Acme. Each {{name}} placeholder is replaced with its default during conversations. Names without a default are left as written. Realtime sessions do not resolve these placeholders.

fields.name: __EscalationEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Escalation
fields.description: Allow this agent to escalate a caller using the settings below. Transfer is not executed today; turn this off to keep the settings without running escalation checks.

fields.name: __EscalationDestination__Voice
fields.label: Escalation Destination
fields.description: Human destination for call escalation, for example a phone number or queue. Leave empty to disable escalation. Transfer is not executed today; this value is stored and documented for a later runtime change.

fields.name: __EscalationCondition__Voice
fields.label: Escalation Condition
fields.description: When a caller should be escalated to the destination above. Transfer is not executed today; this value is stored and documented for a later runtime change.

fields.name: __EscalationFallback__Voice
fields.label: Escalation Fallback
fields.description: What should happen if an escalation cannot complete. Reprompt asks the caller to continue with the agent, Message plays a closing message and continues gracefully, and End closes the call gracefully. The fallback is not executed today; this value is stored and documented for a later runtime change.

selectOptions.label: Reprompt caller
selectOptions.description: Ask the caller to continue with the agent.

selectOptions.label: Play message
selectOptions.description: Play a closing message and continue gracefully.

fields.name: __TranscriptWebhookEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Transcript Webhook
fields.description: Send the transcript to the URL below once a deployed conversation is archived. Turn this off to keep the URL but stop sending.

fields.name: __TranscriptWebhookUrl__Voice
fields.label: Transcript Webhook URL
fields.description: The HTTPS endpoint where the transcript will be sent after a voice conversation is archived.

fields.name: __TranscriptWebhookSecret__Voice
fields.label: Signing secret
fields.description: Used to sign webhook requests so your endpoint can verify that they were sent by the voice agent.

fields.name: __SfxToolCallCueEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Tool Call Sound
fields.description: Play the tool call sound below when a tool runs. Turn this off to keep the sound URL but stop playing it.

fields.name: __SfxToolCallCueUrl__Voice
fields.label: Tool Call Sound
fields.description: URL of a sound played in the browser when a tool is called. Leave empty for silence. Sound plays in the browser only; it is not mixed into phone audio.

fields.name: __SfxAmbienceEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Ambience Sound
fields.description: Play the ambience sound below during a voice session. Turn this off to keep the sound URL but stop playing it.

fields.name: __SfxAmbienceUrl__Voice
fields.label: Ambience Sound
fields.description: URL of a sound looped in the browser during a voice session. Leave empty for silence. Sound plays in the browser only; it is not mixed into phone audio.

fields.name: __SfxEnabled__Voice
fields.label: Enable Sound Effects
fields.description: Turn browser sound effects on. When off, the configured sounds are not played.

fields.name: __VirtualAvatar__Voice
fields.label: Virtual Avatar
fields.description: Not yet available. Coming soon.

fields.name: __ScreenShare__Voice
fields.label: Screen Share
fields.description: Not yet available. Coming soon.

fields.name: __CameraFeed__Voice
fields.label: Camera Feed
fields.description: Not yet available. Coming soon.
